title: Yuukyuu Gensoukyoku 2nd Album (Demo)
overview:
This Time, I Want You to Protect It with Your Friends.

Precious people, precious memories. A precious heart. There are so many things here worth protecting. Every single one of them - the crystals of truth you built with your friends through countless hardships and moments of joy - so that you never lose them, so that you never let them go...

I Want You to Grab Hold of One More HAPPY.

Back in the town of Enfield, you are the last remaining member of the Third Division Vigilante Corps, the group that handles the townspeople's requests and complaints. Once well trusted, the corps lost its spirit and most of its work after the sudden death of its captain. You have one year to restore it to its former glory.

Yuukyuu Gensoukyoku 2nd Album is a raising simulation about friendship and trust. Recruit three companions, work together to take on the town's jobs, and spend your holidays training and getting to know the people around you.

This disc is a demo version of the game.

今度は仲間と、守って欲しい。

大切な人、大切な思い出。大切な心。ここには守るべきものが、やまほどあります。そのひとつひとつのすべてを数々の苦労や喜びの瞬間の中で、仲間たちと築いた真実の結晶を、決して失わないように、決して手放さないように…

またひとつ、HAPPYをつかんで欲しい。
